components.name: location-permission
components.description: Two-step flow: a custom in-page 'use my location' modal, followed by the browser's native geolocation permission prompt.

steps.name: custom-modal

content.illustration: 140x140 red location pin inside fading radar rings
content.heading: Find the nearest Kotak Prime branch
content.hint: Tap Turn on location, then choose “Allow” when your browser asks.

steps.onTrigger: primary button shows a loading spinner in place of its label; native permission prompt (step 2) opens on top; custom modal stays visible underneath

mobile.layout: centered sheet, rounded top corners, dropped from under the status bar
content: Allow kotakprime.in to know your location?

outcomes.allow: native prompt closes; custom modal's loading state resolves and closes; Contact Us city field is expected to auto-populate with the detected nearest city (not captured as its own frame)
outcomes.deny: falls back to the same state as 'Continue without location' — manual city selection via the dropdown
